operation.description:
Lists all self-hosted runner groups configured in an organization and inherited from an enterprise.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: List self-hosted runner groups for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/parameters/page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/page.name: page

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

#/components/parameters/visible-to-repos.description: Only return runner groups that are allowed to be used by this repository.
#/components/parameters/visible-to-repos.name: visible_to_repository

network_configuration_id.description: The identifier of a hosted compute network configuration.

restricted_to_workflows.description: If `true`, the runner group will be restricted to running only the workflows specified in the `selected_workflows` array.

selected_repositories_url.description: Link to the selected repositories resource for this runner group. Not present unless visibility was set to `selected`

selected_workflows.description: List of workflows the runner group should be allowed to run. This setting will be ignored unless `restricted_to_workflows` is set to `true`.

items.description: Name of workflow the runner group should be allowed to run. Note that a ref, tag, or long SHA is required.

workflow_restrictions_read_only.description: If `true`, the `restricted_to_workflows` and `selected_workflows` fields cannot be modified.
